QuestInfo.name: Explorer Level +30 Challenge
QuestInfo.0: They say that a great gift has been prepared to celebrate the improvement of the Explorer skills.
QuestInfo.1: If you increase 30 levels from your current level by July 27th 2010, you can receive one of the following gifts from Cassandra: #b#t1112427#, #t1112428#, #t1112429##k.
QuestInfo.2: You received one of the Explorer rings for increasing 30 levels within the time limit.

0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k! Have you heard that MapleStory is conducting an extensive improvement of the Explorer class skills? You can find more information on our homepage! You're at a high enough level that you should be able to immediately experience the improvements. In any case, I am here on an important mission to hand out some incredible gifts to Explorers as a way of celebrating this occasion.
0.1: Your mission is to 'increase 30 levels higher than your current level.' Would you want to give it a try? The reward you'd receive will be amazing!

item.0: Hmm... It looks like you already have one of the Explorer Rings. Unfortunately, you can only receive one Explorer ring, so I won't be able to give you anymore rings.
